newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Air NZ expands code-share with Ansett Australia.
newsitem.headline: Air NZ expands code-share with Ansett Australia.

text.p: Air New Zealand Ltd said on Wednesday it would expand its code-sharing agreement with Ansett Australia on trans-Tasman routes.
The move would increase the number of code-shared city-to-city flights to over 130 per week, Air NZ said.
The move will roughly double the present number of Air NZ-Ansett code-share flights.
Planes operated by Air NZ will carry the flight number of Ansett, which will sell its allocation of seats as if they were on their own aircraft.
The additional code-share flights will operate from Wellington and Christchurch to Sydney and Brisbane and to Melbourne from Auckland, Wellington and Christchurch.
They were previously operated by Air NZ and Qantas, but the trans-Tasman share agreement is being jointly disbanded on April 30 by the two carriers.
